units.sourceHTML: 2.2.3 Showing Which Sections Differences Are in

units.text: Sometimes you might want to know which part of the files each change falls in. If the files are source code, this could mean which function was changed. If the files are documents, it could mean which chapter or appendix was changed. GNU ⟦0⟧ can show this by displaying the nearest section heading line that precedes the differing lines. Which lines are “section headings” is determined by a regular expression.
